Effort is defined as the reported number of traps hauled
This table Includes only regular commercial harvest records. It excludes any special harvesting, for example under scientific licence, test fishery, etc.

All information presented in this table arises from fishery dependent logbook programs.  Fishery dependent catch reporting relies on individual harvesters or groups of harvesters to monitor and report their own catch.
Dependability of data arising from fishery dependent catch reporting programs is higher for those fisheries which also participate in independent verification such as 3rd party monitoring programs.
Crab trap fisheries are not managed with comprehensive independent verification programs and as such the dependability of the data is unknown.
Please consult the relevant Integrated Fisheries Management Plan for more information about this data. (Available at https://science-libraries.canada.ca/eng/fisheries-oceans/)
